purpose: Bound numerical-aperture, background-estimator and centering contributions before assigning the F090W deficit to a physical cause.
inputs: All 24 cached RC73 SCI/DQ/AREA strips, original exposure centroids and original backgrounds. No Program 7565 pixel access.
comparisons: Change only 12x12 midpoint aperture weights to circle-square overlap integrated by SciPy quadrature; preserve original centroids and backgrounds.
At fixed centroid compare original MAD-clipped annulus background to center-selected annulus with Astropy default standard-deviation clipping.
Perturb centroid by the eight axial and diagonal offsets in {-0.25,0,0.25} pixels. This is a declared sensitivity box, not a confidence region.
Compare r3/r5 and r8/r5 concentration across dithers; a concentration difference does not by itself identify PSF physics.
Count bit-4 and DO_NOT_USE aperture support and inspect local peak rates; do not infer the official global-image peakrate from a strip.
numericalOnlyRescueCriterion: Recomputed F090W excursion <=0.02 AND cross-star pattern difference <=0.01, with no change to flux samples, centroid, background or thresholds.
independentCheck: A JavaScript circle-square antiderivative implementation recomputes aperture flux directly from exported converted pixel cutouts, not Python flux summaries. This validates geometry and sums, not MAST extraction, units, centroids or physical calibration.
stopRules: Missing cached input: stop rather than fetch pixels.
Non-finite pixel with positive aperture weight: refuse qualification.
Independent geometry or flux discrepancy > tolerance: withhold numerical conclusion.
Do not optimize sensitivity settings for a pass or declare a repeated development result an independent holdout.
prospectiveStatus: RC73 outcomes were already known. This design is not a fresh-data preregistration and its local timestamp is not external attestation.
